statement: Let g0 : X0 → Y0 be an algebraic fibre space between smooth projective varieties, with geometric generic fibre of Kodaira dimension zero. After birational modifications of its source and base there is a commutative diagram X′ α − → X0 g ↓ ↓ g0 Y β − → Y0 with X′ and Y smooth, and rational divisors B, M, R such that (6.1) KX′ ∼Q g∗ (KY + B + M) + R. PROJECTIVE HODGE LINES AND ORDINARY SUBADDITIVITY 17 Here B ≥ 0, its support has simple normal crossings, (Y, B) is klt, and M is nef. Moreover, (6.2) g∗OX′ (⌊kR+ ⌋) = OY (k ∈ Z>0), codimY g(Supp R− ) ≥ 2, and R− is α-exceptional. The divisor M is the trace of the moduli b-divisor, which can be assumed to descend to Y . On a sufficiently high generically finite base change admitting semistable reduc- tion, its pullback is Q-linearly equivalent to a positive rational multiple of the Schmid extension of the distinguished canonical Hodge eigensheaf of the canonical root cover.
